title: Ashbury Rewards Co-Brand Card Credit on Room Reservations Room-Type Moves
content:
## Cardholder benefit

A Room Reservations guest whose attached Ashbury Rewards membership has the Ashbury Rewards Premier card linked has the premier card credit of 10.00 taken off the supplement of each night when the reservation is moved to a room type that sleeps its registered adults; one with the Ashbury Rewards card linked has the card credit of 5.00 taken off; a guest with no co-brand card linked has no credit taken off (0.00).

The card is the co-brand card shown as linked on the Ashbury Rewards membership attached to the reservation, as reported by the issuing bank.

| Co-brand card linked to the attached membership | Credit per night (USD) |
|---|---|
| Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 10.00 |
| Ashbury Rewards card | 5.00 |
| None, or no membership attached | 0.00 |

## Where the credit is taken

The credit is taken off the amount the room-type differential comes to for one night, once that amount is otherwise complete, and never takes it below zero; the plan's discount off the Flexible Rate then acts on what remains.

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

| Differential amount for one night | Card | After the credit, never below zero |
|---|---|---|
| 40.00 | Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 30.00 |
| 40.00 | Ashbury Rewards card | 35.00 |
| 8.00 | Ashbury Rewards Premier card | 0.00 |
| 0.00 | Ashbury Rewards card | 0.00 |

With a hypothetical plan discount off the Flexible Rate of 7%, the 30.00 left in the first row becomes 27.90.
